canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon), no trailing newline
comparison_rule: For a changed HEAD regenerate from that actual publication base. For the edited N5 wrapper remove only this new child entry, preserving any older additional_children field/content, then compare to the actual base. These fingerprints are narrow preservation/provenance aids, not a new science gate.
handoff_append_rule: Existing handoff bytes must be an unchanged prefix of the new document.
